question: Which cold-ischemia and storage durations did not adversely influence RNA integrity in fresh-frozen tumor tissue?
query_sent: To assess the impact of cold ischemia and storage duration on RNA integrity, fresh-frozen tumor tissues were collected into RNAlater®-treated tubes within 30 minutes post-resection. Specimens were stored at −80°C for up to one year. RNA quality was evaluated using the RIN (RNA Integrity Number) score from Bioanalyzer analysis. Results showed that tissues stored for up to six months exhibited RIN values ≥7, indicating no significant degradation in RNA integrity. Tissues stored for nine months and one year also maintained acceptable RIN scores of 6-7, suggesting that these storage durations did not adversely influence RNA quality. These findings indicate that fresh-frozen tumor tissue can be safely stored for up to one year without compromising RNA integrity.
